title: CAST: A Cross-Asset State-Space Trading System for Drawdown Control in Stock Markets

split.decision: Calibration 2005–2007; global c from {1,1.5,2} maximizing validation mean CAST Sharpe across four panels and four lambda cells, tie lower MDD then grid order; per-panel lambda from {0.05,0.1,0.3,0.6} maximizing 2008–2009 validation Sharpe. Hidden 2010-01-01..2025-04-30; online filters warmed from complete past, accounts reset at each evaluation block. Sizes (train/val/test): NASDAQ 754/505/3855, CSI300 745/490/3720, TPX100 765/488/3769, Global30 781/521/3989. History included in evaluation inputs. All archived raw_prices match bitwise; no split RNG. Nonfinite c means rank last; when all c means are undefined (zero-trading candidates), select the lowest mean MDD, then original grid order. Per-panel invalid lambda scores rank last.
